title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ（小栗和幸研究室）
subtitle: Design Project III(Oguri Kazuyuki)
educationalGoal:
On the basis of the design and fabrication technology of the basics of aerospace engineering learned so far, the basic ability to design, fabricate and propose feasible ideas on transportation machines by applying aerospace engineering theory will be obtained.
At the same time, students will learn the importance of cooperation with local community to advance their ideas.
Generative AI will also be effectively utilized in research.
advice:
Design Project III is the subject of the collected studies in the final stage of the curriculum. Examples of research subjects at Oguri Lab include the following.

-Surface treatment of composite materials
 Modification and analysis of surfaces by atmospheric pressure and plasma, and fine particle shot blast to obtain better adhesion of bond and paint.
-Surface treatment of metallic materials
 Modification and analysis of surface by fine particle shot peening to obtain better fatigue and anti-corrosion properties, also photocatalytic properties.
-Surface treatment of aircraft materials
 Various surface microfabrications and analysis to obtain electromagnetic shielding and stealth properties.

A detailed project theme is determined through discussion. Students will discover their own problems and solve them. Students will also understand the targets of this subject, the overview of the course and the objectives. In particular, students will understand which part of the learning objectives of this department this subject carries and a detailed level of their achievement.
requiredKnowledge: Because Design Project III is based on the lectures, experiments, and practice of quarters 1 to 6 in the department of aeronautics, students should review them appropriately as needed. In particular, a review of Materials for Aerospace Vehicle Structure and Strength of Materials is needed.

activityGoals.body: Be able to establish a project theme and put it into action based on an engineering design process.
Be able to finalize the results students obtained as documents and conduct a presentation with discussion.
Be able to perform design, drafting, manufacturing (production) and simulation.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1)Students understand the purpose and the promotion process of the project theme and can achieve the ojectives that suit the purpose.
(2)Students should prepare an interim result of the project and present and discuss it. Students should prepare their research result as a final report and present and discuss it in an open presentation and evaluation meeting. In addition, students should announce this final result in the societies which were equal to each specialty domain and can receive outside evaluation.
(3)Students design and manufacture specimens properly by themselves and evaluate them.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1)Students understand the purpose and the promotion process of the project theme and can achieve the annual objectives that suit the purpose.
(2)Students should prepare an interim result of the project accomplishments and present it. Students can prepare the final result as a final report and can present it in an open presentation and evaluation meeting.
(3)Students design and manufacture specimens and evaluate the specimens.
